postings.description:

Digital | Defence | Security | Space

We offer a unique surveillance-as-a-service solution that delivers real-time intelligence, enhancing maritime safety and saving lives. Our products and services support strategic and operational decisions in the most demanding environments — whether at sea, on land, in space, or in cyberspace.

Become part of a dynamic, multidisciplinary, and mission-driven team that is transforming maritime surveillance and redefining global safety standards.

At TEKEVER, our mission is to provide limitless support through mission-oriented game-changers, delivering the right information at the right time to empower critical decision-making.

If you're passionate about technology and eager to shape the future — TEKEVER is the place for you.

Mission:

We are looking for an enthusiastic and technically capable Additive Manufacturing Technician to join our growing Manufacturing team.

This is a hands-on role where you will help establish and operate TEKEVER's additive manufacturing capability, supporting everything from rapid prototypes and engineering development through to production components for our Aerospace and Defence systems.

You will take ownership of additive manufacturing jobs from build preparation through to finished component, working closely with Manufacturing Engineering, Design Engineering and Quality.

If you enjoy solving manufacturing problems, working with advanced technology and seeing an idea turn into a physical component, this is an opportunity to make a real impact.

- Operate and maintain industrial additive manufacturing equipment, including SLS and polymer-based systems.

- Prepare, set up and execute additive manufacturing builds.

- Prepare build files, optimise component orientation and maximise build utilisation.

- Manage material and powder preparation, handling and traceability.

- Depowder, clean and post-process manufactured components.

- Inspect components and identify manufacturing defects or dimensional issues.

- Maintain accurate production, machine and material records.

- Support prototype, R&D and production programmes.

- Work with engineers to develop new additive manufacturing processes and applications.

- Support Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM) activities.7

- Help develop build parameters and manufacturing processes for new components.

- Investigate build failures and implement improvements.

- Support the introduction of new additive manufacturing technologies and equipment.

- Maintain equipment, carry out routine operator maintenance and ensure machines remain production-ready.

- Ensure all work complies with company quality, safety and manufacturing procedures.

- Support FAIRs, inspection documentation, NCRs and full component traceability.

- Identify opportunities to improve machine utilisation, build quality, repeatability and material efficiency.

Essential Skills

- Previous experience working with industrial additive manufacturing / 3D printing equipment.

- Practical manufacturing experience.

- Ability to understand engineering drawings and manufacturing instructions.

- Good understanding of dimensional tolerances and component quality.

- Strong attention to detail.

- A methodical approach to production and documentation.

- Good problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team.

Desirable

- SLS additive manufacturing, particularly PA12.

- EOS, 3D Systems or similar industrial AM equipment.

- Additive manufacturing build preparation and nesting software.

- Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM).

- Aerospace or defence manufacturing.

- AS9100 / AS9102.

- FAIR production.

- GD&T.

- CMM or 3D scanning inspection.

- CNC machining.

- MRP/ERP systems and digital manufacturing traceability.

- Metallic additive manufacturing.

What we have to offer you:

At TEKEVER, we offer a comprehensive package designed to reward, support, and develop our people. This includes a highly competitive salary with a discretionary annual bonus and a company pension contribution match of up to 10%. To support your wellbeing, we provide 25 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays, Private Medical Insurance (with optional family cover), Private Dental care, and an Employee Assistance Programme. We are deeply committed to investing in future talent; our scale allows us to provide clear career development opportunities and dedicated initiatives to boost your skill sets, ensuring you remain future-ready for the evolving workplace. AI Technical Writer

Where? Hybrid between Lisboa & Caldas da Rainha

The role

- Comfort with AI/LLM tooling, version control, and docs-as-code, or strong aptitude to adopt them;

Customs & Transport Analyst
postings.description:
Mission

As our Customs & Transport Analyst, you will be the cornerstone of our international logistics and trade compliance operations. You will own end-to-end customs processes, ensure regulatory compliance across all import/export activities, and optimize our transport flows — with a high degree of independence and accountability for results.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role suited for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, technically complex environment.

Location: Lisbon Office (on-site), with 2 weekly visits to our operational sites in Ponte de Sor, Leiria or Caldas da Rainha.

Key Responsibilities

Customs & Trade Compliance

· Manage all import and export declarations, ensuring full compliance with national and international regulations (EU, US EAR/ITAR, dual-use goods, etc.)

· Classify products under the correct HS/HTS codes, with particular attention to UAV components and electronics

· Obtain and maintain necessary export licenses, permits, and authorizations

· Serve as the primary point of contact with customs authorities, freight forwarders, and brokers

· Prepare and review all necessary documentation for import/export activities, including bills of lading, invoices, and certificates of origin, export licenses

· Monitor regulatory changes and proactively adapt internal procedures accordingly

· Conduct internal compliance audits and maintain accurate trade documentation

Transport & Logistics

· Coordinate and optimize international and domestic shipments (air, sea, road) for components, assemblies, and finished UAV products

· Negotiate rates and service agreements with carriers and logistics partners

· Track shipments, resolve delays or incidents, and ensure on-time delivery performance

· Analyze transport costs and identify optimization opportunities

· Collaborate with procurement, production, and sales teams to align logistics with business needs

Reporting & Continuous Improvement

· Define and track KPIs related to customs compliance, lead times, and freight costs

· Produce regular performance reports for management

· Lead initiatives to improve processes, reduce costs, and mitigate supply chain risks

Required Profile

· Experience: 5+ years in customs, trade compliance, and/or international transport, ideally in a manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or high-tech environment

· Technical Knowledge: Strong command of customs regulations, export control frameworks (EAR, ITAR, dual-use), Incoterms, and international transport modes

· Autonomy: Proven ability to operate independently, manage priorities, and make decisions without constant supervision

· Results-Oriented: Track record of delivering measurable improvements in compliance, cost, or efficiency

· Tools: Proficiency with ERP systems, customs management software, and MS Office / Excel

· Languages: Fluency in English required; additional languages (French, Spanish, etc.) are a plus

· Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, International Trade, Business Administration, Logistics, or a related field; relevant certifications (CCS, CPTM, or equivalent) are a strong advantage

You will work on a variety of projects that involve understanding, processing and generating human language to solve complex problems and create innovative solutions. - Research and Innovation: Stay current with the latest advancements in LLM and Natural Language Processing (NLP) and apply new techniques to improve existing models and develop new solutions.

3. Track supply chain and production risk, including manufacturing readiness at WWA and Swindon, supplier lead times and single points of failure, working with the Supply Chain Lead and the Manufacturing, Assembly & Integration Lead.

4. Track commercial and IP risk, including contract change impact and Design Authority/IP transfer decisions, working with the Commercial Lead.

Internal Collaboration

1. Work closely with the Programme Manager and Programme Controls Manager to keep the Risk and Opportunity Register aligned with the wider programme schedule, budget and change control processes.

2. Support the Programme Director/SRO in preparing risk positions ahead of Authority engagement and negotiation.

3. Coach risk owners across the Delivery team in applying risk ensuring consistent approach across the business.

4. As is consistent with a scaling company, support work outside of core responsibilities where business priorities require. Tekever uses an Agile methodology that requires its workforce to adapt to changing work demands.

- Formal risk management qualification (e.g. APM Risk, M_o_R, IRM) or equivalent.

- Undergraduate degree or equivalent professional experience in a relevant discipline.

- Proven experience establishing and running a risk on a complex programme, including risk identification, scoring, mitigation tracking and escalation.

- Experience reporting risk to senior governance boards and external customers/authorities.

- Experience with UK MOD or equivalent Defence procurement and governance.

- Experience on UAS, ISR or aerospace programmes involving multi-entity Design Authority arrangements.

- Understanding of risk management frameworks and tools (e.g. risk registers, probability/impact scoring, RAID logs) and the ability to apply them practically rather than passively.

- Familiarity with UAS/ISR systems, airworthiness and safety case concepts (MAA, SAIL/OSO, Def Stan 00-56).

- Familiarity with programme controls disciplines (CWBS, PCMP, earned value management).
